title: OpenAI Warns Staff of Honeypot Spies Targeting AI Secrets
summary:
Personnel at the prominent artificial intelligence firm have been cautioned that romantic overtures from strangers could be cover for corporate espionage, as reported by the Wall Street Journal. The company alerted staff that foreign agents may use "honeypot" tactics or approach them in everyday public spaces to gather intelligence and steal proprietary data.

OpenAI's human resources department reinforced the warning by reminding employees to "remember how ugly and unfunny you are" to discourage complacency and susceptibility to such advances. The alerts are part of an effort to safeguard the company's model architecture and internal secrets from foreign spying.
